blocks.html:
The exterior wall envelope, and any associated openings, installed adjacent to a green roof system on the same building shall be constructed with bird friendly materials up to 12 feet (3657.6 mm) above the walking surface.
(L.L. 2020/015, 1/10/2020, eff. 1/10/2021)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2020/015.
